claim.claim-text: a first position where the outer arm surface (222) is spaced from the axis (AX) at a first arm distance (226) greater than the first interface distance (204), and a second position where the outer arm surface (222) is spaced from the axis (AX) at a second arm distance (228) less than the first arm distance (226) and less than or equal to the first interface distance (204).
2. The bit (66) as set forth in claim 1, wherein the interface (124) comprises at least four planar surfaces (220).
3. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1 or 2, wherein the interface (124) comprises at least four corners (218) with two of the corners (218) defining the outermost drive portions (202).

4. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-3, wherein the interface (124) comprises a plurality of drive lobes (245) with two of the drive lobes (245) defining the outermost drive portions (202).

5. The bit (66) as set forth in claim 4, wherein the resilient arm (188) and one of the drive lobes (245) comprise a common bisecting plane (CBP) intersecting the axis (AX) to define two equal portions of the resilient arm (188) and two equal portions of the outermost drive portion (202).
6. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-5, wherein the resilient arm (188) is further defined as a first resilient arm; and

further comprising a second resilient arm extending from the proximal end (178) of the shank (176) to a second arm end, the second resilient arm comprising a second outer arm surface facing away from the axis (AX), and a second retention surface facing toward the distal end (180) of the shank (176) and radially aligned about the axis (AX) with one of the outermost drive portions (202); and wherein the first and second resilient arms (188) are each respectively movable relative to the axis (AX) between:

respective first positions where the respective outer arm surfaces are spaced from the axis (AX) at respective first arm distances greater than the first interface distance (204), and respective second positions where the respective outer arm surfaces are spaced from the axis (AX) at respective second arm distances less than the respective first arm distances and less than or equal to the first interface distance (204).

7. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-6, wherein the resilient arm (188) extends at least partially away from the axis (AX) from the proximal end (178) of the shank (176) to the arm end (200).

8. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-7, wherein the resilient arm (188) comprises a finger portion (234) at the arm end (200), the finger portion (234) providing the retention surface (224).
9. The bit (66) as set forth in claim 8, wherein the finger portion (234) forms a ramp surface (230) configured to deflect the resilient arm (188) toward the axis (AX).

10. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-9, wherein the interface (124) extends along the axis (AX) between a distal interface end (194) and a proximal interface end (196), with an interface length (IL) defined between the distal interface end (194) and the proximal interface end (196); and wherein the retention surface (224) is spaced from the proximal interface end (196) at a retention distance (RD) greater than or equal to the interface length (IL).

11. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-10, wherein the interface (124) extends along the axis (AX) between a distal interface end (194) and a proximal interface end (196), with an interface length (IL) defined between the distal interface end (194) and the proximal interface end (196); and wherein the shank (176) has a shank length defined between the distal end and the proximal end, with the shank length (SL) being greater than or equal to three times the interface length (IL).
12. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-11, wherein the bit (66) is a cannulated drill bit.
13. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-12, wherein the bit (66) is a twist drill bit.

14. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-13, wherein the resilient arm (188) and one of the outermost drive portions (202) are radially positioned within fifteen degrees of one another relative to the axis (AX).

15. The bit (66) as set forth in any one of claims 1-14, wherein the retention surface (224) and one of the outermost drive portions (202) comprise a common bisecting plane (CBP) intersecting the axis (AX) to define two equal portions of the resilient arm (188) and two equal portions of the outermost drive portion (202).
